articles.summary: Murray, Utah - Coda Octopus Engineering, Inc. (formerly Coda Octopus Colmek) is pleased to announce that its accounting system has been found compliant by the Defense Contract Audit Agency (DCAA), enabling the company to accept cost-type contracts from the U.S. Government and Department of Defense.
